reason: Manually tested on Hermes 0.22 with live omp CLI (v18.1.18). All eight workflows verified end-to-end: one-shot, background, session continue, plan-yolo, JSON mode, subagents, model selection, read-only/approval modes.

prompts.name: one-shot-delegation
prompts.prompt: Use omp to fix the failing test in `src/parser.test.ts`. Run the test, explain the root cause in 3 lines. Use `--max-time 600` and `--no-session` since this is a throwaway task.

expectations.text: The omp command uses -p (print mode) for non-interactive execution
expectations.evidence: manual: verified -p flag used in terminal invocation

expectations.text: The omp command includes --max-time with a finite value (e.g., 600)
expectations.evidence: manual: verified --max-time 600 in terminal args

expectations.text: The omp command includes --no-session for throwaway scratch tasks
expectations.evidence: manual: verified --no-session flag present

expectations.text: The omp command specifies workdir=<project root> explicitly
expectations.evidence: manual: verified workdir parameter set to project root

expectations.text: Hermes verifies the test passes by reading the test output rather than trusting omp's claim
expectations.evidence: manual: read tool or terminal output inspection performed after omp returned

prompts.name: background-long-task
prompts.prompt: Use omp to migrate the job queue to Postgres; keep the public API; run the full test suite after. This will take a while, so run it in the background with a 1-hour timeout.

expectations.text: The omp command uses -p (print mode) with --max-time 3600 (or 1h)
expectations.evidence: manual: verified -p --max-time 3600 in terminal args

expectations.text: The terminal call uses background=true and notify=true
expectations.evidence: manual: verified background=true, notify=true in terminal tool call

expectations.text: Hermes explains how to poll the background process or read its log
expectations.evidence: manual: response includes polling/log reading instructions

prompts.name: session-continue
prompts.prompt: The project at `~/proj` already has omp sessions from earlier work. Continue the latest session for that directory and implement fix #2 from the previous investigation report. Use a 15-minute timeout.

expectations.text: The omp command uses -c (continue) flag to resume the latest session for the directory
expectations.evidence: manual: verified -c flag in terminal invocation

expectations.text: The omp command includes -p (print mode) and --max-time 900
expectations.evidence: manual: verified -p --max-time 900 in terminal args

expectations.text: Hermes checks for prior sessions before starting fresh (ls ~/.omp/agent/sessions/)
expectations.evidence: manual: prior session check shown or explained before continue

expectations.text: The prompt references the previous investigation's fix #2, demonstrating session memory reuse
expectations.evidence: manual: prompt text references fix #2 from prior session

prompts.name: plan-yolo
prompts.prompt: Draft a plan for refactoring the authentication module to use JWT instead of session cookies. Investigate the codebase, do NOT edit anything. Output the full plan as markdown. Then, after I review it, implement exactly that plan.

expectations.text: First omp call uses --plan-yolo (or explicit plan prompt) with --no-session and read-only investigation
expectations.evidence: manual: verified --plan-yolo or plan prompt with read-only constraints

expectations.text: Hermes presents the plan to the user for review before the second call
expectations.evidence: manual: plan output shown, user review step occurred

expectations.text: Second omp call implements the reviewed plan with explicit 'Implement exactly this plan:' prompt
expectations.evidence: manual: second call uses plan implementation prompt

expectations.text: The plan includes investigation steps, file changes, and test verification
expectations.evidence: manual: plan contained investigation, file list, test steps

prompts.name: json-mode-parse
prompts.prompt: Run omp in JSON mode (--mode json) with --no-session and --max-time 300 to create a simple Python hello world script. Parse the JSONL output and extract only the final assistant message text.

expectations.text: The omp command includes --mode json
expectations.evidence: manual: verified --mode json in terminal args

expectations.text: Hermes provides Python code to parse newline-delimited JSON events
expectations.evidence: manual: Python parsing code provided in response

expectations.text: The parsing logic takes the LAST turn_end with role=assistant
expectations.evidence: manual: parsing logic correctly targets last assistant turn_end

expectations.text: The extracted answer contains the generated script content
expectations.evidence: manual: extracted output contained hello world script

prompts.name: subagent-delegation
prompts.prompt: Use omp to audit the src/auth directory for security issues. Use the security-reviewer subagent (read-only) to do the audit, do not edit anything. Report all findings.

expectations.text: The omp prompt explicitly names the security-reviewer subagent
expectations.evidence: manual: prompt text includes 'security-reviewer' subagent name

expectations.text: The prompt specifies read-only / do not edit constraint
expectations.evidence: manual: prompt includes read-only constraint

expectations.text: Hermes acknowledges that subagents multiply cost and should be file-disjoint
expectations.evidence: manual: response mentions cost multiplication and file-disjoint ownership

prompts.name: model-selection
prompts.prompt: List available models in omp, then run a task using the 'slow' (deep reasoning) role with the Opus model. Also show how to configure a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

expectations.text: Hermes runs omp models first to list available providers/models
expectations.evidence: manual: omp models invoked before task delegation

expectations.text: The task run uses --slow or --model with Opus identifier
expectations.evidence: manual: verified --slow or --model opus in terminal args

expectations.text: Response explains ~/.omp/agent/models.yml structure for custom endpoints
expectations.evidence: manual: models.yml structure explained with providers/baseUrl/apiKey

prompts.name: readonly-approval
prompts.prompt: Run omp in read-only mode (only read, grep, glob tools) to investigate the codebase without any edits. Also explain the difference between yolo, write, and always-ask approval modes for headless runs.

expectations.text: The omp command includes --tools read,grep,glob (or --no-tools with explicit allows)
expectations.evidence: manual: verified --tools read,grep,glob in terminal args

expectations.text: Response explains yolo = no prompts (default), write = prompt on exec, always-ask = prompt on writes/exec
expectations.evidence: manual: all three modes explained correctly

expectations.text: Response warns that headless -p with prompt/always-ask hangs silently
expectations.evidence: manual: hang warning present in response

expectations.text: Response recommends --auto-approve or --approval-mode yolo for headless runs
expectations.evidence: manual: --auto-approve or --approval-mode yolo recommended
